sentences.text: Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for assistance to Large Industries and Thrust Sector: Net SGST Reimbursement

**Scheme Brief Description:** The "Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for assistance to Large Industries and Thrust Sector" aims to provide incentives to attract increased investments in the manufacturing sector to create more employment opportunities in Gujarat.
**Who is this for:** Business Entity, Industries; Category: Business & Entrepreneurship; Sector: Setting up / start-up / entrepreneurship

**Detailed Description:** The &quot;Aatmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme for assistance to Large Industries and Thrust Sector&quot; is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines Department, Gujarat. It aims to empower the state&#39;s dynamic large-industry sector, which significantly contributes to employment, GDP, and exports. Effective from October 5, 2022, to October 4, 2027, this initiative supports growth, investments, and the vision of &quot;Aatmanirbhar Gujarat&quot; and &quot;Aatmanirbhar Bharat.&quot; The component &quot;Net SGST Reimbursement&quot; is designed to incentivize large industrial undertakings by reimbursing a portion of their SGST for a specific period (10 years), based on the category of their taluka and sector.

**Benefits / Assistance:** **Category of Taluka****General****Thrust**Category 1100% of net SGST for 10 years upto 7.5% of eFCl p.a. 100% of net SGST for 10 years upto 8% of eFCl p.a. Category 290% of net SGST for 10 years upto 6.5% of eFCl p.a. 90% of net SGST for 10 years upto 7% of eFCl p.a. Category 380% of net SGST for 10 years upto 5% of eFCl p.a. 80% of net SGST for 10 years upto 5.5% of eFCl p.a. **Note**: 1. The period of 10 years shall be from the date of commencement of commercial production. 1. List of Taluka categories[.](https://imd.gujarat.gov.in/Document/I%20Branch_2297_02_Nov_2020_98.pdf)

**Application Process:** > **Registration Process:** **Step-1:** Visit the [Investor Facilitation Portal (IFP)](https://ifp.gujarat.gov.in/DIGIGOV/) portal. Click on "New Investor Registration" to access the registration form. **Step-2:** Fill in the Registration Form. Click on "Submit". **Step-3:** Verify the E-mail ID using the link sent on your registered E-mail ID. **Step-4:** After verification, you will be registered successfully.  > **Post-Registration Process:** **Step-1:** Visit the [Investor Facilitation Portal (IFP)](https://ifp.gujarat.gov.in/DIGIGOV/) portal. Click on "Login". **Step-2:** Enter the email address and password you used during registration. **Step-3:** Click the "Login" button to access your account. **Step-4:** Now fill in the required details and mandatory documents about your business to complete the application process.  > **Helpdesk****:** [Contact Here](https://ifp.gujarat.gov.in/DIGIGOV/IFP-pages/contact.jsp?pagedisp=static)
**Contacts & Authorities:** Nodal Department: Industries and Mines Department
